senses.gloss:
लेप, अस्, m. the act of smearing, besmearing,
daubing, anointing, plastering, anything smeared
on, salve, ointment, unguent, plaster, mortar, chu-
nam, white-wash; a coating of paint, &c.; the
wipings of the hand after offering funeral oblations
to three ancestors, (these wipings being considered
as an oblation to paternal ancestors in the fourth,
fifth, and sixth degrees); impurity, dirt, any grease
or dirt sticking to vessels, &c., a spot, stain, pollu-
tion, defilement, moral impurity, sin; food, victuals.
—लेप-कर, अस्, m. plaster-maker, mortar-maker
or plasterer, bricklayer, white-washer.
—लेप-का-
मिनी, f. = अञ्जनी.
—लेप-भागिन्, ई, m. ‘sharing
the Lepa, ‘a paternal ancestor in the fourth, fifth,
and sixth degrees (Manu III. 216).
—लेप-भुज्,
क्, m. ‘eating the Lepa,’ = लेप-भागिन्.

लेप लेप, लेपन, लेप्य, &c. See p. 867,
col. 3.

लेपक, अस्, m. a plasterer, bricklayer; one who
moulds or models; (a form लेपक for लेप is found
at the end of some comps., see अ-ल्˚.)

लेपन, अस्, m. olibanum, incense; (अम्), n.
the act of smearing, besmearing, daubing, spreading
on; anything smeared on, salve, ointment, plaster,
mortar, white-wash; flesh, meat.

लेपनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be smeared or anointed,
fit to be plastered.

लेपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, smearing or besmearing with,
covering with; smeared with, covered with; (ई), m. a
plasterer, bricklayer, one who moulds or models.

लेप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be smeared or anointed;
to be defiled, to be spotted or stained; moulded,
modeled; (अम्), n. plastering, spreading or smearing
ointment or mortar, making models, moulding,
modeling.
—लेप्य-कृत्, त्, m. one who makes
models, a bricklayer, plasterer.
—लेप्य-नारी, f.
(probably) a modeled figure of a woman.
—लेप्य-
[]
मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of mortar or clay, moulded;
(ई), f. a doll, puppet.
—लेप्य-योषित्, त्, f. = लेप्य-
नारी.
—लेप्य-स्त्री, f. a woman covered with un-
guents, a perfumed woman.

लेप् लेप्, cl. 1. A. लेपते, &c., to go; to
worship, serve.
